name: Syed Nafiz Reja Hasib
identity: Computational design and mechanics of structures under seismic loading, with embodied carbon as a design variable; current work spans superelastic NiTi systems and thin-shell form-finding and stability.
bio: I work on computational structural mechanics, seismic resilience, and embodied carbon. After two years of cyclic-durability testing on superelastic NiTi in precision manufacturing, I build verified solvers to test where structural efficiency holds and where it breaks.
currently: Building verified mechanics solvers for seismic and carbon limits.
